TrenchLine — Al-Qarn Rihla

Every number on these boards is real: joined from the August 1320d NewRecruit export against src/data/generated/. Colours, fonts, radii and control sizes lifted from globals.css and the live components.

Top row = phone (375x812, the mobile-first target). Bottom row = detail + desktop.

Three things the current app cannot do, drawn here: two currencies side by side, variant rules that actually block recruitment, and provenance on every value.

Touch targets

Every control here is >=44px. The live app has 122 under that, mostly the 28px steppers in PlayModeView and the 24px chip close buttons in UnitCard. The Play HUD board shows the 44px version.

Ducats vs Glory

1320 / 1320 Ducats and 6 / 9 Glory are two separate budgets and must never share a meter. Glory-priced items (Sniper Scope 2, Jawhar 4, Pairika 7) carry the sun glyph and a warmer gold so they read differently at arm's length.
